content:
samira-newhire: hey all, can't finish onboarding. Okta errors with 'multiple accounts match this identifier' when I try to sign in with my redwood email. also 1password says no seat assigned. who should I ping?

peopleops_emma: welcome! :wave: that Okta message usually means the email alias was previously used by a contractor or test account. pinging @id_admin and @hr_julie to check identity records and provisioning.

id_admin: looking. can you DM me the exact email you tried? also did you get a welcome link or provisioning email with a different address?

samira-newhire: DM'd you the email: samira@redwood.com. I only got the offer email and a calendar invite. no provisioning link.

it_support_bot: Ticket created: #IT-4691 - "Okta duplicate-identifier for samira@redwood.com; 1Password seat missing". Assigned to id_admin. Status: open.

id_admin: confirmed there's a stale contractor identity (samira.contractor@redwood.com) that previously used the same local-part. I'll merge and remap aliases, but that requires HR sign-off to retire the old account. @hr_julie could you confirm?

hr_julie: confirmed the contractor account was closed last quarter. approving alias remap for onboarding. please proceed.

id_admin: remapping now. This will create a new Okta account for samira@redwood.com and clear the collision. It may take ~10-15 minutes to propagate. I'll also request a 1Password seat from people ops if needed.

peopleops_emma: requesting 1Password seat allocation now. ETA ~20m. If you need immediate secrets, we can temporary-share a vault link to your personal email, but prefer company flow.

devex_tom: once Okta is fixed, if you still can't access developer tools, DM me. For SSH key and repo access: generate key with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "samira@redwood.com"` and paste pub key into the profile page.

it_support_bot: Update: #IT-4691 changed status to in_progress (id_admin).

id_admin: Okta entry remapped and old contractor aliases retired. Try signing in now.

samira-newhire: tried — success! got the Okta welcome flow and MFA prompt. 1Password link still says seat pending.

peopleops_emma: 1Password seat granted and invite resent. please accept and set your master password. I've also added you to the team vault.

samira-newhire: accepted 1Password invite and can see team vault. thanks everyone. one small follow-up: my GitHub SSO didn't create a mapping; devex_tom can you add me to org?

devex_tom: will add you to GitHub org and repo access after you share your SSH pub key. also verify your Google Drive access once you're in.

it_support_bot: #IT-4691 resolved. If anything else comes up, reopen the ticket or ping @id_admin.

samira-newhire: thanks all 389 44d feels good to be unstuck on day one!
